COMMIT: OK. The change only swaps colour tokens in three Studio components, updates the tests that match on those strings and updates docs. There are no blocking problems. ## Code Review: round-174 (DUX-R-5a content colour). ArrangementClip, ArrangementDetailPanel, ArrangementOverview, 3 updated tests, 1 new test, docs 141/142/143 I read the full diff, both new files, the clip code around the changed lines (805–955), the detail waveform box (195–251) and the Overview bar colour code. Every new token exists in `app/styles/app.css`, in both the default and the Obsidian theme: `muted`, `muted-bg`, `dim`, `foreground`. `verify.log` shows 173/173 test files passing (including `content-colour-ui.test.tsx`, 6 tests), lint with warnings only and both builds passing. I did not open `c-round-174.json`, so the C PASS is as you reported it. ### Critical Issues - None. - **Auth, purchase and download code: not touched.** Every changed path is under `components/arrangement`, `lib/arrangement/__tests__` or `docs/implementation`. - **Listeners, timers, effects, refs, gesture handlers, `data-*`, aria, layout:** unchanged. The diff only changes className strings. ### Suggestions (ranked) 1. **Low – leftover `cn()` calls with fixed strings.** `ArrangementClip.tsx:859`: `cn('relative min-h-0 flex-1 cursor-text', 'text-muted/70')`. `ArrangementClip.tsx:876-879`: `cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full', 'text-foreground')`. Each used to hold an `isVideo ?` choice; now both arguments are fixed, so `cn()` only adds a call on every clip render. **Fix:** make each a plain className string. DXC6 checks only the retired and kept tokens, not these exact strings, so the tests still pass. This fits in the DUX-R-5b round. 2. **Low – doc 143 status is out of date.** `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/143-…md:4` still says `In Progress (awaiting C round 174)` (TODO line 91 matches), but C round 174 has passed. Doc 142 was marked Completed one round late, in this commit, so leaving 143 for the next commit is consistent. **Fix:** either set `Completed (C round 174 PASS, published )` before committing, or do it next round the way 142 was done. Not blocking. 3. **Low – brittle Overview selector in the new test.** `content-colour-ui.test.tsx:303` finds the bar rows by position (`overview?.children[1]?.children`). Adding a decorative child to the Overview root would break it silently. Root 293–305 currently has the outline overlay as child 0 and the row container as child 1, so it works today. The doc already lists this, and gate-173 deferred the same selector as Low. **Fix:** put it in ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS (the shared test-helper task), or add a `data-overview-rows` attribute in a round where adding `data-*` is allowed. 4. **Info – telling video from audio clips (R31).** Unselected video clips now differ from audio clips by brightness (header about 1.52:1 against the audio header) and by the `Film` vs `GripVertical` icon (`ArrangementClip.tsx:850-854`), not by hue. WCAG 1.4.1 (colour alone) is not broken because of the icon, and the track lane also identifies the clip type. Saba can veto this, as recorded in the doc. No code change. 5. **Info – contrast where `currentColor` is inherited.** In the clip body, the only other text, `audioNote` (`:926`), sets its own `text-muted`. The range label (`:935`) uses `text-background`. In the detail box (`:226`), the video placeholder `

` sets `text-muted`. So `text-muted/70` only reaches the waveform ``, and the 3:1 non-text threshold is the right one. B's figures (3.61–3.98) meet it. ### Real-browser and render-cost check - **Event order:** unchanged. No handlers were added or moved, and pointer-capture and gesture paths are untouched. - **Render cost:** no change apart from the trivial `cn()` call in suggestion 1. `contain-strict` on the detail box is kept. - **Tailwind and tokens:** all theme tokens. No hex, arbitrary values, `style=` or new CSS. - **TypeScript strict:** `OVERVIEW_AUDIO_BAR_CLASSES` stays `as const`, and the index is still clamped (`ArrangementOverview.tsx:57`). The new test has no `any`, suppression directives or non-null assertions. Missing elements throw a labelled error in `tokensOf`. ### Good Practices Found - DXC6 counts source occurrences, checking both that the retired tokens are gone and that the kept brass sites appear exactly once (selection, playheads, Library preview progress). - DXC3 confirms that selection still turns both a video and an audio clip brass, so the neutral header cannot take over a selected clip. - `video-fades-ui.test.tsx:383-388` adds a negative `not.toContain('text-accent')` check next to the positive one. - The doc 143 table of contrast values records what was rejected (`text-dim/70` and `text-muted/60` too close to 3:1, `bg-outline-strong` text only 4.22). ### Architecture note - **Signal 3 (one region changed repeatedly at high cost):** `ArrangementClip.tsx:822-842` and the colour `cn()` blocks have been changed in V-3c-5a/5b and now DUX-R-5a. DUX-R-5b will touch about 150 more `brand`/`accent` sites in 19 files. Each round needs exact-string updates in several tests (panel-radius, detail-panel-polish, video-fades, content-colour). - **Keep for now:** the sites follow one lifecycle, nothing is shared between components, and pulling classes into a central map now would be a one-off abstraction. - **Proposal for the planner (not approved scope):** after DUX-R-5b, consider one test-only task that replaces repeated exact-className checks with role-based token checks (selection, playhead, focus, content) in a small helper. Acceptance criteria: no component changes, the same failure on each of mutations m241–m247, and behaviour tests unchanged. - The fake Web Audio / ResizeObserver harness copied again in `content-colour-ui.test.tsx:23-104` is already recorded as ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS. No new note. This reviews the diff only; I did not review the full modules. ### Alternative Approach (critical logic: not applicable; colour-rule implementation only) - **Current approach:** replace each content colour token in place (R30–R33) and lock the brass sites by counting them in the source. - **Alternative:** add semantic tokens such as `--color-content-wave` and `--color-content-video` in `app.css`, so a future palette change touches only the theme. - **Verdict:** keep the current approach for 5a. The round rules forbid changes in `app/styles/`, and token-level contrast for each surface (elevated, muted-bg, background) is already worked out. Semantic tokens are worth looking at once 5b has assigned a role to every remaining brass site. ### Score: 9/10
